in_hebrew.name: Kenzo
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Wise and Intelligent
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Kenzo הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Japanese name derived from the Chinese characters ‘知’ (chi) meaning ‘know’ and ‘臣’ (samurai) meaning ‘servant’. The name Kenzo can be interpreted as 'wise servant'. In Japan, it was a common name for samurai leaders.
